videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences, and absolutely no English.
Key points from the transcript:
1. DRAM prices have increased 4-5 times in half a year (from 100,000+ won to 700,000+ won) - called "RAM-mageddon"
2. The reason is not just demand increase, but supply structure change
3. Memory companies (Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron) are pouring all factory capacity into HBM (AI high-performance memory) because it's more profitable
4. This caused shortage of regular DRAM production capacity
5. Big Tech (Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta) are investing 980 trillion won in AI infrastructure this year (70% increase from last year)
6. This money flows to data centers → AI chips (NVIDIA) → memory chips
7. This price strength is expected to continue until 2027, some companies sold out 2026 production already
Structure for summary (3-5 sentences, ~500 characters):
Opening: DRAM prices surged 4-5x in 6 months due to supply shortage (RAM-mageddon)
Reason: Manufacturers shifted all capacity to high-margin HBM for AI, reducing regular DRAM supply
Money flow: Big Tech's 980 trillion won AI investment → data centers → AI chips → memory companies (Samsung, etc.)
Outlook: This structural supply shortage will continue until 2027
